messages:
Alex M: Kickoff — I'm going to start the staged rollout for model_v2 (text-gen/7B) in ~15m. Plan: 1) 1% global for 30m, 2) 5% EU for 45m, 3) 15% global with canary routing for low-latency regions. Toggle key: `ff.model_v2.enabled` + traffic split `routing.model_v2.split`. Any objections/last-minute checks?
Maria S: Quick Q — what are the exact abort thresholds? need them for the SLO dashboard.
Samir K: Proposed aborts: >20% increase in p95 latency, >0.5% error rate, or any spike in auth failures. Also watch token-cost bump. Alerts: `alerts/model_v2_latency` and `alerts/model_v2_error_rate`.
Alex M: putting that in the runbook now. Also adding a soft-fallback to model_v1 for any routed errors. Snippet for split config: ```json
{
  "default": "model_v1",
  "variants": [
    {"model": "model_v2", "weight": 0.01},
    {"model": "model_v1", "weight": 0.99}
  ]
}
```
Priya R: I'll watch the EU slice + do the first manual check at +30m. @Samir K can you confirm the dashboard has the correct labels (`region`, `slice`, `model_version`)?
Samir K: Confirmed — dashboards live at https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/model_v2. Labels look good. I added a short query to compare token efficiency between v1/v2.
Diego: Code review ping: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/pull/512 — contains the flag flip and rollout job. Need one more LGTM for merge.
Priya R: LGTM — checked the toggle logic and fallback.
Alex M: deploy-bot, can you schedule the rollout job now?
deploy-bot: Scheduled job `rollout/model_v2/1749994321` to start in 10m. Watch channel `#incidents` for automated alerts. :rocket:
Samir K: Small ask — add a metric for short-circuit cache hit rate, sometimes v2 increases cold-starts. If cache-hit drops >15% abort.
Alex M: Adding cache-hit abort rule. Final plan: abort if any of [p95 +20%, error_rate >0.5%, cache_hit_drop >15%, auth_fail spike]. On-call: Priya R first hour, Samir K second hour. I'll flip `ff.model_v2.enabled` to true at start time.
Priya R: I'll post a 30m and 1h status in this thread. Good to go from my side. :+1:
Diego: Merged PR, CI green.
Alex M: Thanks all — starting in 5m. Ping here for any anomalies and we'll hit the kill switch `ff.model_v2.enabled = false` if needed.
